## Day 1
Yuanfang 12/4/2025 7:05 PM
I've given the setup some thought, and had a look at the potential combinations of PRs, and I was thinking that, if the following roles are present in the game: Masons can absolutely claim day 1.
This is because the masons show up in double goon and Roleblocker scenarios, and when double masons are present, Roleblocker is as good as goon. We can simply narrow down the setup to a Mason 9er, instead of wasting time on hypotheticals. Furthermore, Masons are relatively expendable compared to other PRs, so we don't lose out on too much if they're killed.
Neighbour can also consider claiming day 1.
Neighbour only exists in Rolecop games. By claiming, we immediately know there is a Rolecop in the game. Of course, this runs the risk of a N1 Neighbour kill, losing out on some info, so Neighbour doesn't 100% have to claim. If the Neighbour is present in the game, I'll leave the decision up to them.
No other power role should claim day 1 unless their role has been fakeclaimed or if they're being pushed
I think this is pretty straightforward. As a sidenote, though, you don't need to claim even if you've been fakeclaimed. It could very well be a Mafia trying to bait out a PR for a kill, or a cit trying to take a kill for a PR. The choice to counterclaim is there, but try to think about why the claim is there before you make the decision to counterclaim or not.

Neighbour can also consider claiming day 1.
Neighbour only exists in Rolecop games. By claiming, we immediately know there is a Rolecop in the game. Of course, this runs the risk of a N1 Neighbour kill, losing out on some info, so Neighbour doesn't 100% have to claim. If the Neighbour is present in the game, I'll leave the decision up to them.
No other power role should claim day 1 unless their role has been fakeclaimed or if they're being pushed
I think this is pretty straightforward. As a sidenote, though, you don't need to claim even if you've been fakeclaimed. It could very well be a Mafia trying to bait out a PR for a kill, or a cit trying to take a kill for a PR. The choice to counterclaim is there, but try to think about why the claim is there before you make the decision to counterclaim or not.

I've given the setup some thought, and had a look at the potential combinations of PRs, and I was thinking that, if the following roles are present in the game: Masons can absolutely claim day 1.
This is because the masons show up in double goon and Roleblocker scenarios, and when double masons are present, Roleblocker is as good as goon. We can simply narrow down the setup to a Mason 9er, instead of wasting time on hypotheticals. Furthermore, Masons are relatively expendable compared to other PRs, so we don't lose out on too much if they're killed.
Neighbour can also consider claiming day 1.
Neighbour only exists in Rolecop games. By claiming, we immediately know there is a Rolecop in the game. Of course, this runs the risk of a N1 Neighbour kill, losing out on some info, so Neighbour doesn't 100% have to claim. If the Neighbour is present in the game, I'll leave the decision up to them.
No other power role should claim day 1 unless their role has been fakeclaimed or if they're being pushed
I think this is pretty straightforward. As a sidenote, though, you don't need to claim even if you've been fakeclaimed. It could very well be a Mafia trying to bait out a PR for a kill, or a cit trying to take a kill for a PR. The choice to counterclaim is there, but try to think about why the claim is there before you make the decision to counterclaim or not.
